Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Voice capture for customer story — quick availability?

Hi Neha,

We had a great experience with the pilot and the product team asked if we could participate in a short case story — 20–30 minute conversation to capture outcomes and a couple of soundbites. Would you be able to share a couple of windows next week?

Attendees from our side would be me (PM) and likely Elena Chen (Head of Product). We can do a remote call; recording is fine as long as we review quotes beforehand.

No heavy prep on our side — just an agenda and any consent form you need us to sign. Happy to coordinate calendar slots.

Best,
Paul Sullivan
Product Manager, Atlassia Health
paul.sullivan@atlassiahealth.com

Hi Paul — thanks, glad the pilot went well. We'd love to capture a short story.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Tue Oct 12, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed Oct 13, 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Agenda (very light):
1) 5 min intros + context
2) 10–15 min discussion of outcomes / metrics you tracked
3) 5–10 min quick quotes and next steps

Attached: agenda_v1.docx (we'll edit during prep) and a short consent form for recording and quote usage. If you prefer not to sign in advance we can capture consent live.

If one of those slots works, I can send a calendar invite and a recording release form to sign. Also please confirm whether Elena will join so we can list stakeholders.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Hi Neha — thanks for the options. Tue Oct 12, 10:00–10:30 AM PT works for us.

Elena will join and is copied here. Recording is fine and we confirm we are happy for Redwood to record and use short quotes, provided we get a chance to review them before publication. Happy to sign the consent form — I'll have our legal person take a look.

One small request: please include a brief question on how Redwood impacted latency/cost in practice — that was a key win for internal stakeholders.

I'll forward any redline from legal if it shows up; otherwise assume OK to proceed.

Best,
Paul
